verses.1: And concerning those who are called “archives,” we have one such archivist, who sits on the right side of the throne of glory in the heavens.
verses.2: The holy ones’ ministers and the true stage of performance, which the Lord created, are not human beings.
verses.3: For every high priest, it is necessary for him to offer gifts and sacrifices as well. Therefore, it is also necessary for this one to bring something as an offering as well.
verses.4: If, then, he was on earth, he certainly could not be a priest, since those who offered donations according to the law were priests.
verses.5: (They worship them as examples and as symbols of the heavens. Just as Moses was commanded to create those shadows, so too, it is said, one should do everything according to the pattern that is shown to you on that mountain.)
verses.6: Now, there are no different functions at all; it’s just a matter of having a strict rule regarding who can make such announcements. This rule applies to those who have the authority to make such announcements.
verses.7: For if the first one was not available, then surely the second one would not be sought after as a suitable place.
verses.8: For I will bring them back to life, he says. “Look, days of light are coming,” he says. “I will make a new covenant between Israel and Judah.”
verses.9: It wasn’t according to the terms of the treaty that I made them take their children away from Egypt on the day I took their hands. They didn’t comply with those terms. I refused to do so, said the Lord.
verses.10: For this covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord, you shall give me laws to follow. And I will write them in their hearts. Then I will make them God’s people, and they shall be my people.
verses.11: And they will not teach each citizen of their community, nor each brother of theirs. They will say, “Know the Lord, so that everyone may know me from the smallest to the greatest among them.”
verses.12: For I will not forgive their injustices, nor will I remember their sins anymore.
verses.13: In speaking of the “New One,” he made the first one obsolete; while the old one continued to exist and grow more and more obsolete over time.
